record.question: Which ART regimen is recommended as the first-line treatment under national guidelines?
record.explanation: Answer B: Tenofovir + Lamivudine + Dolutegravir (TLD). India’s national HIV treatment program recommends tenofovir plus lamivudine plus dolutegravir (TLD) as a first-line adult regimen in the applicable guideline. Source/context note: Regimens depend on age, pregnancy, renal function, resistance, and current NACO guidance. Reference: https://naco.gov.in/sites/default/files/Antiretroviral%20Therapy%20Guidelines%202021.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
